name: Bash

input.command:
cd .. && mkdir -p layers/cart/app/{composables,components,utils,middleware} && 
git mv app/composables/useCart.ts app/composables/useCartTotal.ts app/composables/useDiscount.ts layers/cart/app/composables/ &&
git mv app/components/cart layers/cart/app/components/cart &&
git mv app/utils/discount.ts layers/cart/app/utils/ &&
git mv app/middleware/cart-not-empty.ts layers/cart/app/middleware/ &&
printf "export default defineNuxtConfig({\n  components: { dirs: [] },\n})\n" > layers/cart/nuxt.config.ts
L=layers/cart/app
sed -i '' "s#~/composables/#\#layers/cart/app/composables/#; s#~/utils/discount#\#layers/cart/app/utils/discount#" $L/*/*.ts $L/components/cart/*.vue
sed -i '' "s#~/components/cart/#\#layers/cart/app/components/cart/#; s#~/composables/useCart'#\#layers/cart/app/composables/useCart'#" app/pages/*.vue app/pages/products/*.vue app/components/*.vue
grep -rn "~/.*\(cart\|Cart\|discount\|Discount\)" app layers; rmdir app/middleware 2>/dev/null
npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -15; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
